input.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Intel's foundry business reached break-even in Q4 2026. Break-even means operating income/loss of approximately zero (>=0).

The evidence provided only covers periods through Q3 2026 (period ending September 26, 2026). The most recent Intel Foundry financial performance data is from E4, which shows:
- Q3 2026: Operating loss of $(1,853) million, Operating loss % of (28)%
- Nine months ended Sep 26, 2026: Operating loss of $(6,379) million

While E4 shows the foundry business was still operating at a loss in Q3 2026, there is no evidence provided that covers Q4 2026 (which would typically end around December 2026). The claim specifically refers to "fourth-quarter 2026 results," but none of the evidence passages contain Q4 2026 financial results for the Intel Foundry segment.

E2 mentions expectations for Q4 2026 regarding charges from the Israel facility accident, but does not provide actual Q4 2026 foundry results or indicate whether the foundry business reached break-even.

Without Q4 2026 actual results for Intel Foundry's operating income/loss, I cannot verify whether the foundry business reached break-even in that quarter.
